title: 22.16. Kusalattika, Saraṇaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ nasaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā akusalo saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.

Nakusalaṁ naaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naabyākataṁ naaraṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakusalaṁ naaraṇañca naabyākataṁ naaraṇañca dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
